reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2, E3) shows that SPS combined with ball milling produces non-equilibrium phases and good corrosion resistance in Mg-Ti-Zn alloys, but it does not mention annealing-induced transformation to stable intermetallics, nor does it address high-temperature oxidation behavior at all. The key mechanistic link between metastable-to-stable transformation and improved properties is therefore unsupported.
premises: Spark plasma sintering (SPS) induces metastable phases in Mg-containing lightweight high-entropy alloys
These metastable phases transform into stable intermetallic compounds upon annealing
The formation of stable intermetallic compounds improves corrosion resistance
The formation of stable intermetallic compounds improves high-temperature oxidation resistance
